This '''six-armed alien bounty hunter''' was seen on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] attacking [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Extremely difficult to defeat, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] could evade attacks by quickly "cartwheeling" at or away from their enemy.
